messages.subject: Project Drake — SPA revised draft
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam,

Our counter-redline attached. We've moved to meet you on the commercials: escrow at 15 months, de minimis £35k, threshold £300k, and a 22.5% general cap. On the restrictive covenants we've come down to 30 months (not two years) — reasonable given Stephen's continuing role and the customer concentration. We've held the tax covenant as drafted.

I think this is very close. Shall we aim to sign mid-January?

James

messages.plaintextBody:
James,

That works for our clients. 30 months on the non-compete is accepted. We're finalising the Disclosure Letter and will send the data room index as the disclosure bundle. Let's target signature for 16 January and completion once the CMA position and the Clydesford and Stratton consents are confirmed.

Adam
